title: Deleting a bound file together with its unit gives a defined verdict (pass, or an L4 question when a law on the unit is removed), while keeping the unit is a head E-unbound

assert.why: A.6.4.6: deleted bound file and unit give a defined verdict, here pass
A.6.4.1: nothing in the base errors; the head has no unit left to bind
A.6.4.3: the base unit's binding resolves over M_h to ∅ (identity and file gone), so its summary protects no position and L1 has no part (A.8.2.3); L2 is retired (A.0.7)
A.8.2.3: summaries are decided by L1 only
A.3.3.2: the head keeps unit u with no identity named u; A.15.1 subject
A.7.5.1 rule 9: latent loosening at normal
A.8.2.3 L4: a removed law is loosened; A.8.3.2: L4 affected = Req identities, empty because the base binding resolves to ∅ (A.6.4.3); delta 'L4 removed' (A.12.8.7)
L2 is retired (A.0.7): the removed summary raises no part
